name: Signal Task Lamp
shortDescription: A low-glare steel lamp with a weighted, compact footprint.
description: Signal casts a deliberate pool of warm light without taking over the desk. Its articulated arm holds position with one hand, while the powder-coated shade keeps glare below eye level.

name: Fold Letter Tray
shortDescription: One folded sheet of aluminium, sized for loose notes and A4 paper.
description: Fold gives incoming paper one clear place to land. A raised edge makes sorting easy and a cork underside keeps the tray quiet on timber or metal surfaces.

name: Rail Pen Rest
shortDescription: A solid ash rail for the tools currently in use.
description: Rail keeps three daily writing tools visible and still. Each groove is hand-routed, sanded smooth and finished with a matte plant oil that lets the grain remain tactile.

name: Margin Bookend
shortDescription: A slim architectural stop for notebooks and reference books.
description: Margin makes a sharp boundary on open shelves and desktops. The offset bend adds strength without visual weight; a soft silicone foot protects the surface below.

name: Index Desk Caddy
shortDescription: Four precise compartments for small tools, cards and cables.
description: Index groups the small objects that usually drift. The removable divider supports different working habits, from analogue stationery to a compact charging station.

name: Plane Monitor Riser
shortDescription: A thin steel plane that lifts screens and clears visual noise.
description: Plane raises a monitor by ten centimetres and creates a calm bay for a keyboard below. Two folded legs leave the centre open, while rubber pads prevent movement.

name: Pin Note Weight
shortDescription: A palm-sized brass weight for tracing paper and loose notes.
description: Pin is turned from solid brass and left unlacquered to gather a personal patina. Its shallow centre dimple makes it easy to lift without looking.

name: Grid Catchall
shortDescription: A tactile moulded tray for keys, clips and end-of-day pocket objects.
description: Grid brings order to the smallest loose things. Made from recycled paper pulp, its low compartments feel soft in use and can be recycled again at end of life.
